I know there definitely were some in bunkers near the sawmill, my guys stashed some goods there before. But they got driven out of there by those TerraGroup people, who then locked the bunkers with a key of some sort. Anyway, I don't care where you find them, but I need you to get them fresh and untouched by some traders.
